patches.name: Caption request diagnostics
patches.description: Opt-in, memory-only caption request diagnostics with a Morphe settings viewer/copy/clear entry. Does not fix, retry, or change captions. Requires official Captions and settings add-on support (1.42.0+). Structure checked on YouTube 21.13.164; phone verification pending.

patches.name: HansFix - Simplified Chinese captions
patches.description: Maps Traditional auto-translation to Simplified across caption menus. Independent of the official caption Cookie setting; compatible with official patches. Structure-checked, without an exact version restriction.

patches.name: Remember subtitle language
patches.description: Always remembers the last selected global subtitle language and opens matching captions on new videos. Includes auto-translation and HansFix support. No settings switch. Verified structure: YouTube 21.13.164; other versions require matching structures.
